# e2b_template_tags (Resource)

Assigns tag aliases to an E2B template build.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "e2b_template_tags" "production" {
  template_id = "tpl_123"
  target      = "example-template:build-123"
  name        = "example-template"
  tags        = ["production", "stable"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tags` (Set of String) Tag aliases to assign to the template build.
- `target` (String) Template build target to tag, usually a fully qualified template name such as `my-template:build-tag`.
- `template_id` (String) Template ID used to list assigned tags.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Template name to use when deleting tags. Defaults to the part of `target` before the last colon.

### Read-Only

- `build_id` (String) Build ID returned by E2B when tags were assigned.
- `id` (String) Template ID used for tag readback.
